reason: Both correctly identified 4C as a water supply fault and got the valve opened, but Conversation 2 asked the key diagnostic question about recent plumbing work, correctly read the 90-degree slot as closed on the first reply, told the user to isolate power and water before touching the inlet filter, and sensibly deferred filter checks until the valve fix was tried.
